subject: Request: Launch-week surge headroom — addendum & true-up proposal
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@lumenai.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, May 30, 2026 at 9:12 AM PDT
Subject: [LumenAI] Urgent: Launch-week surge — temporary headroom request

Hi Rachel,

Quick note — our product launch on June 2 is looking much bigger than our forecasted baseline. We just got a last-minute partner integration and expect a sustained traffic spike that could be ~4x our usual token consumption for a 48–72 hour window, with elevated tail traffic for the following week. Can Redwood provision temporary capacity/headroom for launch week and advise on overrun billing and any available discount if we commit to a 12‑month volume plan afterwards?

Attached is our near-term traffic forecast and the partner integration notes. We need an operational answer today if possible so we can finalize runbooks.

Stakeholders: Julia Park (product), procurement@lumenai.com.

Thanks —
Julia Park
Head of Product
LumenAI

[Attachment: lumen-traffic-forecast.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@lumenai.com>
Cc: procurement@lumenai.com
Date: Sat, May 30, 2026 at 10:03 AM PDT
Subject: Re: [LumenAI] Urgent: Launch-week surge — temporary headroom request

Hi Julia — thanks for the heads-up and the forecast. We can support a temporary headroom for launch week; below is a provisional path that balances availability with predictable economics.

Proposal (provisional):
- Scope: Temporary 4x quota uplift (burst capacity) starting 2026-06-02 00:00 PDT for up to 30 days.
- Billing: Overrun (tokens above baseline commit) billed at a blended overrun multiplier. Standard surcharge is 1.5x; we can offer a promotional uplift multiplier of 1.3x for the first 30 days if LumenAI executes the attached addendum and commits to a 12‑month minimum thereafter.
- Cap: Daily safeguard cap equal to 6x baseline to prevent runaway costs; Redwood will pause further burst if cap exceeded and notify you.
- True-up: Any temporary uplift will be reconciled at month-end; consumption above the baseline will be invoiced as overrun with the agreed multiplier, and should you convert to committed volume within 30 days we will credit a portion of the overrun charges (details in attached addendum).

Next steps we need from you:
1) Confirm procurement contact who will sign the addendum (I cc'd procurement@lumenai.com but please confirm legal/PO path).
2) Approve the start date (we can stage capacity earlier if you want a warm-up).
3) Sign the addendum (DocuSign link once you confirm).

I attached a draft addendum for your review. If you want, I can loop in Marissa (my manager) and Ben (finance) to fast-track approvals.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0197

[Attachment: lumen-pricing-addendum-v1.pdf (pdf)]

Subject: Fwd: [LumenAI] Urgent: Launch-week surge — temporary headroom request

Marissa / Ben — forwarding urgent request from LumenAI. Key points: they need a 4x temporary uplift starting June 2 for launch-week, asking for a favorable true-up discount if they convert to a 12‑month commit. Attached forecast.

My suggested commercial: promotional overrun multiplier = 1.3x (vs standard 1.5x) for first 30 days conditioned on a 12‑month commit and signed addendum. Also include a daily safeguard cap.

Marissa — will need your sign-off on the exception to promotional rates.
Ben — can finance do the 1.3x for 30 days and provide crediting language if they convert? If not, propose alternatives (e.g., 1.35x or a fixed credit).

Thanks —
Rachel

Subject: Re: Fwd: [LumenAI] Urgent: Launch-week surge — temporary headroom request

Thanks for the context. Finance reviewed the ask. We can approve a promotional overrun multiplier of 1.3x for the first 30 days, with the following conditions:

- Condition 1: LumenAI signs the attached addendum and commits to a 12‑month minimum (commit size to be defined in the addendum).
- Condition 2: All overrun consumption will be invoiced at the promotional multiplier; if they convert to commit within 30 days, we will apply a one-time credit equal to 50% of the promotional overrun charges (applied to month-1 invoice after conversion).
- Condition 3: Any usage above the daily safeguard (6x baseline) requires explicit ops sign-off and may be billed at the standard 1.5x without retroactive credit.

If Marissa signs off on the commercial exception, I can prep the final finance verbiage for DocuSign. We should also make sure legal is looped for standard indemnities.

-Ben
